literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 提供者对风疹 IgG 筛查的依从性从干预前的 63.3% 增加到干预后的 75.1%,增加了 11.8%。 [The Measles Serology Initiative: A Quality Improvement Intervention to Increase Provider Compliance with Rubeola Serolog]
CRISPR-Cas12a 检测检测到每个反应低至 10 个拷贝的 MeV 模板,Probit 回归估计的 LoD95 为每个反应 32.25 个拷贝,优于单独的 RT-LAMP(每个反应 97.32 个拷贝)。该检测显示出很高的分析特异性,与其他常见呼吸道病毒没有交叉反应,并且在 45-50 分钟内完成。 [10.1038/s41598-026-65706-y]
CD 光谱表明,除了少数例外,突变 降低了融合后核心稳定性,尽管它们与增强的融合活性有关。结构分析揭示了 HR2 内的空间堆积、氢键网络和螺旋稳定相互作用的局部扰动,而整体 6HB 结构保持保守。 [10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00182]
XGBoost 的 AUC-ROC 为 0.838(准确度 81.3%;F1 0.840;MCC 0.624),社会人口因素对 暴发 预测的贡献最大(41.37%),其次是气候(39.22%)和医疗保健相关变量(19.41%)。 [10.1186/s12879-026-14067-y]
与SRN相比,SR9时间表将长期平均发病率减少了2.5倍,将流行间期间隔从5.75年延长至6.12年,将峰值发病率减半,平滑了暴发动态,并降低了一岁以下儿童和18岁以上成人的发病率。 [10.31631/2073-3046-2026-25-3-58-66]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The overall societal cost of the outbreak was estimated at $5.4 million, with $53,522 per case and $1,817 per contact. The largest component of the public health response was vaccination-related activities, which accounted for about $2.1 million of the $3.2 million total response costs. [10.7326/annals-26-00718]

Provider adherence to Rubeola IgG screening increased from 63.3% pre-intervention to 75.1% post-intervention, representing an 11.8% increase. [The Measles Serology Initiative: A Quality Improvement Intervention to Increase Provider Compliance with Rubeola Serolog]

The CRISPR-Cas12a assay detected MeV templates down to 10 copies per reaction, with a Probit regression-estimated LoD95 of 32.25 copies per reaction, outperforming RT-LAMP alone (97.32 copies per reaction). [10.1038/s41598-026-65706-y]
CD spectroscopy showed that, with few exceptions, the mutations decreased postfusion core stability despite their association with enhanced fusion activity. [10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00182]

XGBoost achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.838 (accuracy 81.3%; F1 0.840; MCC 0.624), and sociodemographic factors contributed most to the outbreak prediction (41.37%), followed by climatic (39.22%) and healthcare-related variables (19.41%). [10.1186/s12879-026-14067-y]

papers.title: Economic Impact of the 2025 New Mexico Measles Outbreak: Highlighting the Cost of Efforts to Prevent Future Outbreaks
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In 2025, the United States experienced its highest measles case count since 1992. In New Mexico, 100 confirmed measles cases (99 outbreak-related cases), including 1 death, occurred across 9 counties from February through September 2025. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the societal economic burden of this outbreak while highlighting public health expenditures for vaccination-related activities that supported outbreak control and prevention of future outbreaks. DESIGN: Cost analysis from a societal perspective to estimate 3 types of costs: public health response costs, direct medical costs, and productivity losses. SETTING: Nine counties in New Mexico during February to September 2025. PARTICIPANTS: 133 public health responders, 100 patients with confirmed measles, and 205 exposed contacts. INTERVENTION: Public health response activities, including vaccination campaigns, case management, and contact tracing. MEASUREMENTS: Costs were categorized as response costs (labor, materials, travel), direct medical costs (third-party), or productivity losses (illness, isolation, quarantine, caregiving). RESULTS: The overall societal cost was estimated at $5.4 million ($53 522 per case, or $1817 per contact). The largest component of the public health response to the outbreak (about $3.2 million) was costs from vaccination-related activities (about $2.1 million). LIMITATIONS: Costs may be overestimated or underestimated due to incomplete reporting; insurance data were used rather than actual medical costs; certain direct medical costs were excluded; and assumptions were made for productivity losses. CONCLUSION: These estimates offer important insights for decision making by policymakers and public health stakeholders regarding budgets for and expansion of vaccination coverage during an outbreak and strengthening outbreak preparedness. This study also highlights the societal value of protecting communities from vaccine-preventable diseases like measles, which can be effectively prevented through high vaccination coverage. PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE: None.

papers.title_zh: 2025 年新墨西哥州 麻疹 暴发 的经济影响:强调预防未来 麻疹 的努力成本
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: In 2025, the United States experienced its highest measles case count since 1992. In New Mexico, 100 confirmed measles cases (99 outbreak-related cases), including 1 death, occurred across 9 counties from February through September 2025. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the societal economic burden of this outbreak while highlighting public health expenditures for vaccination-related activities that supported outbreak control and prevention of future outbreaks. DESIGN: Cost analysis from a societal perspective to estimate 3 types of costs: public health response costs, direct medical costs, and productivity losses. SETTING: Nine counties in New Mexico during February to September 2025. PARTICIPANTS: 133 public health responders, 100 patients with confirmed measles, and 205 exposed contacts. INTERVENTION: Public health response activities, including vaccination campaigns, case management, and contact tracing. MEASUREMENTS: Costs were categorized as response costs (labor, materials, travel), direct medical costs (third-party), or productivity losses (illness, isolation, quarantine, caregiving). RESULTS: The overall societal cost was estimated at $5.4 million ($53 522 per case, or $1817 per contact). The largest component of the public health response to the outbreak (about $3.2 million) was costs from vaccination-related activities (about $2.1 million). LIMITATIONS: Costs may be overestimated or underestimated due to incomplete reporting; insurance data were used rather than actual medical costs; certain direct medical costs were excluded; and assumptions were made for productivity losses. CONCLUSION: These estimates offer important insights for decision making by policymakers and public health stakeholders regarding budgets for and expansion of vaccination coverage during an outbreak and strengthening outbreak preparedness. This study also highlights the societal value of protecting communities from vaccine-preventable diseases like measles, which can be effectively prevented through high vaccination coverage. PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE: None.

papers.title: District-level measles outbreak prediction in Bangladesh using geospatial artificial intelligence
papers.abstract: Measles has re-emerged as a growing public health threat despite the availability of a safe and effective vaccine. In Bangladesh, recurring outbreaks and widening immunization disparities underscore the urgent need for proactive district-level risk assessment. This study developed an explainable machine learning framework to identify drivers of and forecast district-level measles outbreak risk in Bangladesh. District-level measles surveillance data (2017–2023) were combined with climatic, socio-demographic, healthcare capacity, and vaccination indicators. Eight machine learning classifiers (Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost, and an Elastic Net GLM) were compared using temporal train /test splitting, and nested cross-validation with F1-optimised decision thresholds selected within training fold. XGBoost was selected based on superior AUC-ROC and Matthews Correlation Coefficient. SHapley Additive exPlanations quantified predictor contributions on measles outbreak prediction. The model was retrained on the full 2017–2023 dataset to forecast district-level outbreak probabilities for 2024–2028, with 95% confidence intervals. Measles showed marked spatiotemporal heterogeneity shifting from northeastern districts during 2017–2018 toward the Dhaka periphery during 2021–2023. XGBoost achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.838 (accuracy 81.3%; F1 0.840; MCC 0.624), supporting risk-based district prioritisation rather than precise case-level prediction. Sociodemographic factors contributed most to the outbreak prediction(41.37%), followed by climatic(39.22%) and healthcare-related variables(19.41%). Vaccination coverage showed lower standalone importance, reflecting contextual risk modulation. Minimum temperature, household size, and poverty headcount were the dominant predictors of measles outbreak prediction. Sylhet, Kushtia, and Dhaka were most vulnerable districts of measles outbreak, while Khulna and Chittagong divisions maintained persistently elevated risk through 2028. Measles outbreak risk in Bangladesh is shaped by climatic and socioeconomic vulnerabilities alongside vaccination gaps. Explainable machine learning can support precision immunisation and targeted surveillance, while requiring cautious interpretation of forecast uncertainty.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究开发了一个可解释的机器学习框架,使用 2017 年至 2023 年地区级 麻疹 监测 数据来识别孟加拉国地区级 麻疹 暴发 风险的驱动因素并预测。
elements_zh.methods: 使用时间训练/测试分割和嵌套交叉验证与 F1 优化的决策阈值对八个机器学习分类器进行了比较,并且 SHapley Additive exPlanations 量化了预测器对 麻疹 暴发 预测的贡献。
elements_zh.main_results: XGBoost 的 AUC-ROC 为 0.838(准确度 81.3%;F1 0.840;MCC 0.624),社会人口因素对 暴发 预测的贡献最大(41.37%),其次是气候(39.22%)和医疗保健相关变量(19.41%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明孟加拉国的 麻疹 暴发 风险是由气候和社会经济脆弱性以及 疫苗接种 差距造成的,他们强调了使用可解释的机器学习来支持精准免疫和有针对性的 监测 的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为有针对性的 疫苗接种 活动、精准免疫策略和地区级风险优先排序提供信息,以减轻孟加拉国的 麻疹 暴发 影响。

papers.title_zh: 使用地理空间人工智能在孟加拉国进行区级 麻疹 暴发 预测
papers.source_body_en: Measles has re-emerged as a growing public health threat despite the availability of a safe and effective vaccine. In Bangladesh, recurring outbreaks and widening immunization disparities underscore the urgent need for proactive district-level risk assessment. This study developed an explainable machine learning framework to identify drivers of and forecast district-level measles outbreak risk in Bangladesh. District-level measles surveillance data (2017–2023) were combined with climatic, socio-demographic, healthcare capacity, and vaccination indicators. Eight machine learning classifiers (Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost, and an Elastic Net GLM) were compared using temporal train /test splitting, and nested cross-validation with F1-optimised decision thresholds selected within training fold. XGBoost was selected based on superior AUC-ROC and Matthews Correlation Coefficient. SHapley Additive exPlanations quantified predictor contributions on measles outbreak prediction. The model was retrained on the full 2017–2023 dataset to forecast district-level outbreak probabilities for 2024–2028, with 95% confidence intervals. Measles showed marked spatiotemporal heterogeneity shifting from northeastern districts during 2017–2018 toward the Dhaka periphery during 2021–2023. XGBoost achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.838 (accuracy 81.3%; F1 0.840; MCC 0.624), supporting risk-based district prioritisation rather than precise case-level prediction. Sociodemographic factors contributed most to the outbreak prediction(41.37%), followed by climatic(39.22%) and healthcare-related variables(19.41%). Vaccination coverage showed lower standalone importance, reflecting contextual risk modulation. Minimum temperature, household size, and poverty headcount were the dominant predictors of measles outbreak prediction. Sylhet, Kushtia, and Dhaka were most vulnerable districts of measles outbreak, while Khulna and Chittagong divisions maintained persistently elevated risk through 2028. Measles outbreak risk in Bangladesh is shaped by climatic and socioeconomic vulnerabilities alongside vaccination gaps. Explainable machine learning can support precision immunisation and targeted surveillance, while requiring cautious interpretation of forecast uncertainty.

papers.title: Comparative evaluation of the effectiveness of measles immunization regimens using agent-based modeling methods
papers.abstract: Achieving and sustaining measles control requires optimization of vaccination schedules that account for demographic changes, immunity dynamics, and infection transmission patterns. A comparative assessment of the long-term effectiveness of different immunization schedules using modern modeling techniques is a relevant scientific and practical task. To conduct a comparative assessment of the long-term epidemiological effect of different measles vaccination schedules using the developed agent-based simulation model. Materials and Methods . A spatially implicit agent-based stochastic model was developed, integrating modules for demography, migration, maternal and vaccine-induced immunity, and age-specific spatial contacts. In a series of 100-year simulations for a population of 100,000 agents, three scenarios were compared: a standard twodose schedule (SRN: 12 months and 6 years), a schedule with an earlier first dose (SR9: 9 months and 6 years, strict timeliness window), and a schedule with a booster dose (SR3: 12 months, 6 and 18 years). The analysis focused on the long-term average incidence, inter-epidemic intervals, and the age distribution of cases. The SR9 scenario demonstrated a statistically significant 2.5-fold reduction in the long-term average incidence compared to the baseline SRN scenario. SR9 was associated with longer inter-epidemic intervals (6.12 years vs. 5.75 years for SRN), a twofold reduction in peak incidence, and smoother outbreak dynamics. The age distribution of cases showed a significant reduction in incidence both among children under one year and among adults (18+) in the SR9 scenario compared to SRN and SR3. The introduction of a booster dose (SR3) did not lead to a significant reduction in long-term average incidence compared to the standard schedule. Optimization of the vaccination calendar involving an earlier administration of the first dose (9 months) combined with strict control over vaccination timeliness can provide a more significant and sustained reduction in measles incidence compared to standard or extended booster schedules. The obtained results highlight the importance of refining the age at vaccination initiation and regulating the timing of vaccine administration as key factors for long-term epidemiological control.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need to optimize measles vaccination schedules to sustain control amid demographic shifts, immunity dynamics, and transmission patterns, identifying a gap in comparative long-term effectiveness assessments of different regimens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research used a spatially implicit agent-based stochastic model to simulate measles transmission over 100 years in a population of 100,000 agents, comparing three vaccination schedules: standard two-dose (SRN), earlier first dose (SR9), and booster-including (SR3).
analysis.methods: The agent-based model integrated demography, migration, maternal and vaccine-induced immunity, and age-specific spatial contacts to simulate measles transmission and evaluate outcomes across vaccination scenarios.
analysis.main_results: The SR9 schedule reduced long-term average incidence 2.5-fold compared to SRN, extended inter-epidemic intervals from 5.75 to 6.12 years, halved peak incidence, smoothed outbreak dynamics, and lowered incidence in children under one year and adults aged 18+.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that earlier first-dose administration with strict timeliness control yields superior and more sustained measles control than standard or booster schedules, highlighting vaccination timing as a key determinant of long-term epidemiological impact.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that refining the age at first vaccination and enforcing strict timeliness could substantially improve measles control strategies, informing vaccination policy and future schedule optimization efforts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on a simulated population and assumptions about contact patterns and immunity dynamics limits direct applicability to real-world settings, warranting cautious interpretation and further empirical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study used an agent-based model to compare the long-term effectiveness of three measles vaccination schedules over 100 years in a simulated population of 100,000 agents. The schedule with an earlier first dose at 9 months (SR9) significantly reduced average incidence by 2.5-fold, extended inter-epidemic intervals, halved peak incidence, and smoothed outbreak dynamics compared to the standard two-dose schedule (SRN). SR9 also lowered incidence in infants under one year and adults aged 18+, whereas adding a booster dose (SR3) did not significantly reduce incidence versus SRN. The authors conclude that optimizing the age at first vaccination and enforcing strict timeliness can enhance measles control. However, the findings are based on simulations and require real-world validation due to model assumptions about demography, immunity, and contact patterns.

papers.source_body_en: Achieving and sustaining measles control requires optimization of vaccination schedules that account for demographic changes, immunity dynamics, and infection transmission patterns. A comparative assessment of the long-term effectiveness of different immunization schedules using modern modeling techniques is a relevant scientific and practical task. To conduct a comparative assessment of the long-term epidemiological effect of different measles vaccination schedules using the developed agent-based simulation model. Materials and Methods . A spatially implicit agent-based stochastic model was developed, integrating modules for demography, migration, maternal and vaccine-induced immunity, and age-specific spatial contacts. In a series of 100-year simulations for a population of 100,000 agents, three scenarios were compared: a standard twodose schedule (SRN: 12 months and 6 years), a schedule with an earlier first dose (SR9: 9 months and 6 years, strict timeliness window), and a schedule with a booster dose (SR3: 12 months, 6 and 18 years). The analysis focused on the long-term average incidence, inter-epidemic intervals, and the age distribution of cases. The SR9 scenario demonstrated a statistically significant 2.5-fold reduction in the long-term average incidence compared to the baseline SRN scenario. SR9 was associated with longer inter-epidemic intervals (6.12 years vs. 5.75 years for SRN), a twofold reduction in peak incidence, and smoother outbreak dynamics. The age distribution of cases showed a significant reduction in incidence both among children under one year and among adults (18+) in the SR9 scenario compared to SRN and SR3. The introduction of a booster dose (SR3) did not lead to a significant reduction in long-term average incidence compared to the standard schedule. Optimization of the vaccination calendar involving an earlier administration of the first dose (9 months) combined with strict control over vaccination timeliness can provide a more significant and sustained reduction in measles incidence compared to standard or extended booster schedules. The obtained results highlight the importance of refining the age at vaccination initiation and regulating the timing of vaccine administration as key factors for long-term epidemiological control.

papers.title: CRISPR-based dual-mode detection of measles virus for laboratory and point-of-care applications
papers.abstract: Abstract Rapid, sensitive, and field-deployable diagnostic tools are crucial for effective outbreak management. To address this need, we developed a one-pot, contamination-free assay integrating reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification (RT-LAMP) with clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR-Cas12a) for the rapid and precise detection of the measles virus (MeV). RT-LAMP primers were designed to target conserved regions of the MeV genome. Reaction conditions—including temperature, MgSO 4, deoxynucleotide triphosphates (dNTPs), and Bst polymerase concentrations—were systematically optimized to achieve robust amplification. CRISPR RNA (crRNA) was designed to target these regions. CRISPR-Cas12a reagents were preloaded into the tube lid. Following RT-LAMP amplification, CRISPR reagents were added to the tubes and mixed by manual shaking. CRISPR-Cas12a demonstrated highly specific target recognition and collateral reporter cleavage activities. Fluorescence detection in laboratory settings and lateral-flow readouts in point-of-care applications were evaluated. Representative sensitivity experiments detected MeV templates down to 10 copies per reaction, while Probit regression analysis estimated LoD 95 of 32.25 copies per reaction, compared with 97.32 copies per reaction RT-LAMP alone. The assay demonstrated high analytical specificity, with no cross-reactivity observed against other common respiratory viruses. The MeV-CRISPR assay was completed within 45–50 min. Overall, this platform provided rapid, sensitive, and specific detection of MeV, showing strong potential for field applications in outbreak surveillance.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a one-pot, contamination-free assay integrating RT-LAMP with CRISPR-Cas12a for rapid and precise detection of the measles virus.
analysis.methods: RT-LAMP primers and CRISPR RNA (crRNA) were designed to target conserved regions of the MeV genome, with reaction conditions optimized for robust amplification. CRISPR-Cas12a reagents were preloaded into tube lids and mixed manually after RT-LAMP amplification.
analysis.main_results: The CRISPR-Cas12a assay detected MeV templates down to 10 copies per reaction, with a Probit regression-estimated LoD95 of 32.25 copies per reaction, outperforming RT-LAMP alone (97.32 copies per reaction). papers.title_zh: 基于 CRISPR 的 麻疹病毒 双模式检测,适用于实验室和护理点应用
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Rapid, sensitive, and field-deployable diagnostic tools are crucial for effective outbreak management. To address this need, we developed a one-pot, contamination-free assay integrating reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification (RT-LAMP) with clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR-Cas12a) for the rapid and precise detection of the measles virus (MeV). RT-LAMP primers were designed to target conserved regions of the MeV genome. Reaction conditions—including temperature, MgSO 4, deoxynucleotide triphosphates (dNTPs), and Bst polymerase concentrations—were systematically optimized to achieve robust amplification. CRISPR RNA (crRNA) was designed to target these regions. CRISPR-Cas12a reagents were preloaded into the tube lid. Following RT-LAMP amplification, CRISPR reagents were added to the tubes and mixed by manual shaking. CRISPR-Cas12a demonstrated highly specific target recognition and collateral reporter cleavage activities. Fluorescence detection in laboratory settings and lateral-flow readouts in point-of-care applications were evaluated. Representative sensitivity experiments detected MeV templates down to 10 copies per reaction, while Probit regression analysis estimated LoD 95 of 32.25 copies per reaction, compared with 97.32 copies per reaction RT-LAMP alone. The assay demonstrated high analytical specificity, with no cross-reactivity observed against other common respiratory viruses. The MeV-CRISPR assay was completed within 45–50 min. Overall, this platform provided rapid, sensitive, and specific detection of MeV, showing strong potential for field applications in outbreak surveillance.

papers.title: Hyperfusogenic Mutations Destabilize the Postfusion Six-Helix Bundle of the Measles Virus Fusion Glycoprotein.
papers.abstract: Fusion of the host membrane and viral envelope by class I viral fusion proteins is driven by the assembly of a postfusion six-helix bundle formed through antiparallel interactions between N-terminal (HR1) and C-terminal (HR2) heptad-repeat regions. Although mutations in these regions of the measles virus (MeV) fusion (F) glycoprotein are known to promote neuropathogenic and hyperfusogenic phenotypes, their effects on postfusion core stability have not been systematically examined. Here, we combine peptide biophysics and X-ray crystallography to interrogate how mutations within the HR2 domain, present in native neuropathogenic MeV isolates (e.g., L454W and N462K) and laboratory-generated hyperfusogenic variants (e.g., L454M and T461A), influence postfusion 6HB assembly. Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy reveals that, with few exceptions, these mutations decrease postfusion core stability, despite their association with enhanced fusion activity. We also report the first crystal structure of the wild-type MeV postfusion core as well as structures of six hyperfusogenic variants, enabling high-resolution comparison of the molecular basis of destabilization. Structural analysis shows that these effects arise from localized perturbations to steric packing, hydrogen bonding networks, and helix-stabilizing interactions within HR2, while the overall 6HB architecture remains conserved. Together, these results indicate that hyperfusogenic mutations are not associated with stabilization of the postfusion state and are instead consistent with models in which hyperfusogenicity arises from a reduction in the energetic barrier to fusion, potentially through effects on prefusion stability or triggering efficiency. These findings establish key sequence-structure-stability relationships governing coiled-coil assembly and provide a framework for the design of HR1- and HR2-based fusion inhibitors.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how mutations in the measles virus (MeV) fusion glycoprotein’s heptad-repeat regions (HR1/HR2) affect the stability of the postfusion six-helix bundle (6HB). elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究结合肽生物物理学和 X 射线晶体学,检查 MeV 融合 (F) 糖蛋白 HR2 结构域中的 突变,包括来自天然神经致病分离株 (L454W、N462K) 和实验室产生的超融合变体 (L454M、T461A) 的 突变。
elements_zh.methods: 使用圆二色性 (CD) 光谱来评估融合后核心稳定性,并确定野生型 MeV 融合后核心和六种超融合变体的高分辨率晶体结构,以比较 6HB 内的分子相互作用和空间堆积。
elements_zh.main_results: CD 光谱表明,除了少数例外,突变 降低了融合后核心稳定性,尽管它们与增强的融合活性有关。结构分析揭示了 HR2 内的空间堆积、氢键网络和螺旋稳定相互作用的局部扰动,而整体 6HB 结构保持保守。

papers.source_body_en: Fusion of the host membrane and viral envelope by class I viral fusion proteins is driven by the assembly of a postfusion six-helix bundle formed through antiparallel interactions between N-terminal (HR1) and C-terminal (HR2) heptad-repeat regions. Although mutations in these regions of the measles virus (MeV) fusion (F) glycoprotein are known to promote neuropathogenic and hyperfusogenic phenotypes, their effects on postfusion core stability have not been systematically examined. Here, we combine peptide biophysics and X-ray crystallography to interrogate how mutations within the HR2 domain, present in native neuropathogenic MeV isolates (e.g., L454W and N462K) and laboratory-generated hyperfusogenic variants (e.g., L454M and T461A), influence postfusion 6HB assembly. Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy reveals that, with few exceptions, these mutations decrease postfusion core stability, despite their association with enhanced fusion activity. We also report the first crystal structure of the wild-type MeV postfusion core as well as structures of six hyperfusogenic variants, enabling high-resolution comparison of the molecular basis of destabilization. Structural analysis shows that these effects arise from localized perturbations to steric packing, hydrogen bonding networks, and helix-stabilizing interactions within HR2, while the overall 6HB architecture remains conserved. Together, these results indicate that hyperfusogenic mutations are not associated with stabilization of the postfusion state and are instead consistent with models in which hyperfusogenicity arises from a reduction in the energetic barrier to fusion, potentially through effects on prefusion stability or triggering efficiency. These findings establish key sequence-structure-stability relationships governing coiled-coil assembly and provide a framework for the design of HR1- and HR2-based fusion inhibitors.
papers.abstract_zh: I 类病毒融合蛋白的 宿主 膜和病毒包膜的融合是由融合后六螺旋束的组装驱动的,该六螺旋束是通过 N 端 (HR1) 和 C 端 (HR2) 七肽重复区域之间的反平行相互作用形成的。尽管已知 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 融合 (F) 糖蛋白这些区域中的 突变 会促进神经病理性和过度融合表型,但它们对融合后核心稳定性的影响尚未得到系统检查。在这里,我们结合肽生物物理学和 X 射线晶体学来探究 HR2 结构域内的 突变 如何影响融合后 6HB 组装,突变 存在于天然神经致病性 MeV 分离株(例如 L454W 和 N462K)和实验室产生的超融合变体(例如 L454M 和 T461A)中。圆二色性 (CD) 光谱表明,除了少数例外,这些 突变 会降低融合后核心稳定性,尽管它们与增强的融合活性有关。我们还报告了野生型 MeV 融合后核心的第一个晶体结构以及六种超融合变体的结构,从而能够对不稳定的分子基础进行高分辨率比较。结构分析表明,这些效应是由 HR2 内的空间堆积、氢键网络和螺旋稳定相互作用的局部扰动引起的,而整体 6HB 结构仍然保守。总之,这些结果表明,超融合性 突变 与融合后状态的稳定无关,而是与融合能量障碍减少而产生的超融合性模型一致,可能是通过对融合前稳定性或触发效率的影响。这些发现建立了控制卷曲螺旋组装的关键序列-结构-稳定性关系,并为基于 HR1 和 HR2 的融合抑制剂的设计提供了框架。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解释了为什么 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 融合糖蛋白七联体重复区域 (HR1/HR2) 中的某些 突变 会导致融合过度和神经病理性表型,尽管对融合后核心稳定性的影响尚不清楚。其目的是解决有关 突变 如何影响融合后六螺旋束 (6HB) 组装稳定性的知识差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究结合肽生物物理学和 X 射线晶体学,检查 MeV 融合 (F) 糖蛋白 HR2 结构域中的 突变,包括来自天然神经致病分离株 (L454W、N462K) 和实验室产生的超融合变体 (L454M、T461A) 的 突变。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用圆二色性 (CD) 光谱来评估融合后核心稳定性,并确定野生型 MeV 融合后核心和六种超融合变体的高分辨率晶体结构,以比较 6HB 内的分子相互作用和空间堆积。
analysis_zh.main_results: CD 光谱表明,除了少数例外,突变 降低了融合后核心稳定性,尽管它们与增强的融合活性有关。结构分析揭示了 HR2 内的空间堆积、氢键网络和螺旋稳定相互作用的局部扰动,而整体 6HB 结构保持保守。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为超融合性 突变 破坏融合后状态稳定的证据,这与超融合性是由于融合能量障碍减少而产生的模型一致,可能是通过对融合前稳定性或触发效率的影响。该研究提供了野生型 MeV 融合后核心的第一个晶体结构和六种超融合变体的结构,建立了关键的序列-结构-稳定性关系。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对 麻疹病毒 进入的基于 HR1 和 HR2 的融合抑制剂的设计提供了信息,并可能指导减轻与特定 麻疹病毒 相关的过度融合或神经病理表型的策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的优势在于其生物物理和结构方法的整合,但它并没有直接评估预融合稳定性或触发效率,从而部分推断了与超融合性的机制联系。证据是中等的,因为它依赖于体外模型和结构比较,而没有功能融合测定或体内验证。

papers.title: Effect of armed conflict on measles surveillance and zero-dose vaccination status in Tigray, Ethiopia, 2018–2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Armed conflict disrupts health systems, undermining routine immunization and disease surveillance. These disruptions can delay outbreak detection and allow population susceptibility to accumulate unnoticed. This study assessed the impact of the 2020–2022 conflict in Tigray, Ethiopia, on measles epidemiology, focusing on surveillance reporting, age distribution of cases, and vaccination status. Methods We conducted a retrospective longitudinal analysis of national case-based measles surveillance data from Ethiopia (2018–2024; n = 69,866). Changes in measles surveillance, age distribution, and zero-dose vaccination status across the pre-conflict (2018–2019), conflict peak (2020–2022), and post-conflict recovery (2023–2024) periods were examined. Two-way analysis of variance examined regional differences in age at infection across phases. Multivariable logistic regression estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs) for confirmed measles cases being unvaccinated (zero-dose), using the pre-conflict period as the reference and adjusting for age and sex. Surveillance quality was assessed using demographic data completeness. Results During the conflict peak, reported measles cases from Tigray declined to 0.01% of nationally reported cases, consistent with near-total surveillance collapse. After hostilities ended, a marked pediatric shift emerged, with the median age of infection in Tigray declining from 24.0 years during the conflict to 5.0 years in the post-conflict period ( p < 0.0001), a pattern not observed in other regions. Compared with the pre-conflict baseline, the odds that a confirmed measles case was zero-dose were substantially higher during the conflict peak (aOR: 71.43; 95% CI: 14.1–1000.0) and remained elevated during post-conflict recovery (aOR: 2.49; 95% CI: 1.17–5.52). During the conflict peak, 50% of confirmed cases in Tigray lacked sex-disaggregated data. Conclusion The conflict was associated with a near-complete collapse of measles surveillance, marked changes in the age distribution of reported cases, and an increased proportion of zero-dose measles cases. These findings highlight the need for resilient surveillance systems and targeted catch-up vaccination during post-conflict recovery.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study demonstrates that armed conflict can severely disrupt measles surveillance and vaccination programs, leading to undetected outbreaks and accumulation of susceptible populations. It underscores the importance of strengthening surveillance and implementing catch-up vaccination strategies in post-conflict settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on surveillance data, which may be incomplete or biased during conflict, particularly with 50% of confirmed cases lacking sex-disaggregated data during the conflict peak. Despite these limitations, the evidence is strong due to the clear temporal association between conflict phases and observed changes in surveillance quality, age distribution, and vaccination status.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the impact of the 2020–2022 armed conflict in Tigray, Ethiopia, on measles epidemiology using national surveillance data from 2018–2024. During the conflict peak, measles surveillance in Tigray collapsed to 0.01% of national reports, and the median age of infection shifted from 24.0 to 5.0 years post-conflict. The odds of confirmed measles cases being unvaccinated (zero-dose) increased dramatically during the conflict (aOR: 71.43) and remained elevated afterward (aOR: 2.49). These findings indicate that conflict disrupts both surveillance and vaccination programs, increasing susceptibility and delaying outbreak detection. The study highlights the urgent need for resilient surveillance systems and targeted catch-up vaccination in post-conflict recovery.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 武装冲突扰乱卫生系统并破坏常规免疫和疾病 监测,可能会延迟 暴发 检测并导致易感性在不被注意的情况下累积。本研究评估了 2020-2022 年埃塞俄比亚提格雷冲突对 麻疹 流行病学 的影响,重点关注 麻疹 报告、病例年龄分布和 疫苗接种 状态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对埃塞俄比亚(2018-2024 年;n = 69,866)的国家基于案例的 麻疹 监测 数据进行了回顾性纵向分析。对冲突前(2018-2019)、冲突高峰(2020-2022)和冲突后恢复(2023-2024)期间麻疹、年龄分布和零剂量疫苗接种状态的变化进行了检查。
elements_zh.methods: 双向方差分析检查了各阶段感染年龄的区域差异。使用冲突前时期作为参考并调整年龄和性别,多变量逻辑回归估计了未接种疫苗(零剂量)的确诊 麻疹 病例的调整优势比 (aOR)。监测 质量是使用人口统计数据完整性进行评估的。
elements_zh.main_results: 在冲突高峰期间,提格雷报告的 麻疹 病例下降至全国报告病例的 0.01%,与 麻疹 几乎全部崩溃的情况一致。敌对行动结束后,儿科出现了明显的转变,提格雷感染的中位年龄从冲突期间的 24.0 岁下降到冲突后时期的 5.0 岁(p < 0.0001)。与冲突前基线相比,冲突高峰期间确诊的 麻疹 病例零剂量的几率明显较高(aOR:71.43;95% CI:14.1-1000.0),并且在冲突后恢复期间保持较高水平(aOR:2.49;95% CI:1.17-5.52)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 此次冲突与 麻疹 麻疹 几乎完全崩溃、报告病例年龄分布的显着变化以及零剂量 麻疹 病例比例增加有关。这些发现凸显了在冲突后恢复期间需要有弹性的 监测 系统和有针对性的追赶 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究表明,武装冲突会严重扰乱 麻疹 监测 和 疫苗接种 计划,导致未被发现的 暴发 和易受影响人群的积累。它强调了在冲突后环境中加强 监测 和实施追赶 疫苗接种 战略的重要性。

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Armed conflict disrupts health systems, undermining routine immunization and disease surveillance. These disruptions can delay outbreak detection and allow population susceptibility to accumulate unnoticed. This study assessed the impact of the 2020–2022 conflict in Tigray, Ethiopia, on measles epidemiology, focusing on surveillance reporting, age distribution of cases, and vaccination status. Methods We conducted a retrospective longitudinal analysis of national case-based measles surveillance data from Ethiopia (2018–2024; n = 69,866). Changes in measles surveillance, age distribution, and zero-dose vaccination status across the pre-conflict (2018–2019), conflict peak (2020–2022), and post-conflict recovery (2023–2024) periods were examined. Two-way analysis of variance examined regional differences in age at infection across phases. Multivariable logistic regression estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs) for confirmed measles cases being unvaccinated (zero-dose), using the pre-conflict period as the reference and adjusting for age and sex. Surveillance quality was assessed using demographic data completeness. Results During the conflict peak, reported measles cases from Tigray declined to 0.01% of nationally reported cases, consistent with near-total surveillance collapse. After hostilities ended, a marked pediatric shift emerged, with the median age of infection in Tigray declining from 24.0 years during the conflict to 5.0 years in the post-conflict period ( p < 0.0001), a pattern not observed in other regions. Compared with the pre-conflict baseline, the odds that a confirmed measles case was zero-dose were substantially higher during the conflict peak (aOR: 71.43; 95% CI: 14.1–1000.0) and remained elevated during post-conflict recovery (aOR: 2.49; 95% CI: 1.17–5.52). During the conflict peak, 50% of confirmed cases in Tigray lacked sex-disaggregated data. Conclusion The conflict was associated with a near-complete collapse of measles surveillance, marked changes in the age distribution of reported cases, and an increased proportion of zero-dose measles cases. These findings highlight the need for resilient surveillance systems and targeted catch-up vaccination during post-conflict recovery.

papers.title: National campaign for measles vaccination, verification, catch-up, and response among children and adolescents under 18 years
papers.abstract: In 2023, Morocco experienced a nationwide measles outbreak. From October 2023 to March 2025, a national campaign of measles vaccination, verification, catch-up, and response was launched, targeting children and adolescents under 18 years of age. This study aims to assess and comprehensively describe the campaign’s impact on measles vaccination coverage, highlighting the need to address post-COVID-19 immunization disruptions. Verification rates, incompleteness levels, and catch-up coverage were estimated using national campaign data, and regional disparities were assessed using descriptive statistics, box plots, and principal component analysis (PCA). Results were compared with the international literature on efforts to control measles, particularly in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs). The overall campaign coverage was high, with an average verification rate of 96.64%, particularly strong in the Oriental region, where the rate exceeded 100%, likely reflecting denominator underestimation and/or cross-boundary vaccination flows. However, substantial inter-regional disparities were observed in catch-up rates, ranging from 79.05% in Eddakhla-Oued Eddahab to as low as 16.12% in Guelmim-Oued Noun. These disparities may reflect differences in geographic accessibility, health system capacity, and sociodemographic factors across regions. The national incompleteness rate stood at 15.69%, indicating significant room for improvement. Service disruptions resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic contributed to the decline in immunization rates before the campaign. While the campaign was associated with improved verification and strengthened measles vaccination coverage, regional disparities and incomplete coverage persisted. In the quest for sustainable measles control, Morocco will require targeted interventions, including school-based vaccination, digital reminder systems, and enhanced community engagement, to achieve its elimination goals, informed by best practices from other parts of the world.

analysis.research_question_and_background: In 2023, Morocco experienced a nationwide measles outbreak, creating a pressing public-health need to restore vaccination coverage after COVID-19–related disruptions. The study was motivated by the gap between pre-campaign coverage and elimination targets and aimed to evaluate the national campaign’s impact on measles vaccination coverage.
analysis.study_design_and_population: From October 2023 to March 2025, Morocco conducted a national campaign of measles vaccination, verification, catch-up, and response targeting children and adolescents under 18 years of age. The campaign’s coverage and disparities were assessed using national campaign data and regional analyses.
analysis.methods: Verification rates, incompleteness levels, and catch-up coverage were estimated using national campaign data, and regional disparities were assessed with descriptive statistics, box plots, and principal component analysis (PCA). Results were compared with international literature on measles control in low- and middle-income countries.
analysis.main_results: The overall campaign coverage was high, with an average verification rate of 96.64%, particularly strong in the Oriental region where the rate exceeded 100%. Substantial inter-regional disparities were observed in catch-up rates, ranging from 79.05% in Eddakhla-Oued Eddahab to 16.12% in Guelmim-Oued Noun, and the national incompleteness rate stood at 15.69%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The campaign was associated with improved verification and strengthened measles vaccination coverage, but regional disparities and incomplete coverage persisted. The authors highlight the need for targeted interventions such as school-based vaccination and digital reminder systems to achieve elimination goals.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform Morocco’s measles elimination strategy by identifying priority regions and recommending tailored interventions to address geographic, health-system, and sociodemographic barriers to vaccination.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on campaign data and descriptive analyses limits causal inference and generalisability, and the use of PCA for regional disparities introduces methodological assumptions. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the lack of control groups or long-term follow-up.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2023 年,摩洛哥经历了全国范围内的 麻疹 暴发,从而产生了在 COVID-19 相关中断后恢复 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的紧迫公共卫生需求。这项研究的动机是运动前覆盖率与消除目标之间的差距,旨在评估全国运动对 麻疹 疫苗接种 覆盖率的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年10月至2025年3月,摩洛哥针对18岁以下儿童青少年开展了全国“麻疹、疫苗接种、核查、追赶和应对”活动。使用国家活动数据和区域分析来评估该活动的覆盖范围和差异。
elements_zh.methods: 使用国家活动数据估计验证率、不完整性水平和追赶覆盖率,并使用描述性统计、箱线图和主成分分析(PCA)评估区域差异。结果与低收入和中等收入国家 麻疹 控制的国际文献进行了比较。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该活动与改进验证和加强 麻疹 疫苗接种 覆盖范围相关,但地区差异和覆盖不完整的情况仍然存在。作者强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施,例如基于学校的 疫苗接种 和数字提醒系统,以实现消除目标。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: In 2023, Morocco experienced a nationwide measles outbreak, creating a pressing public-health need to restore vaccination coverage after COVID-19–related disruptions. The study was motivated by the gap between pre-campaign coverage and elimination targets and aimed to evaluate the national campaign’s impact on measles vaccination coverage.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: From October 2023 to March 2025, Morocco conducted a national campaign of measles vaccination, verification, catch-up, and response targeting children and adolescents under 18 years of age. The campaign’s coverage and disparities were assessed using national campaign data and regional analyses.
analysis_en.methods: Verification rates, incompleteness levels, and catch-up coverage were estimated using national campaign data, and regional disparities were assessed with descriptive statistics, box plots, and principal component analysis (PCA). Results were compared with international literature on measles control in low- and middle-income countries.
analysis_en.main_results: The overall campaign coverage was high, with an average verification rate of 96.64%, particularly strong in the Oriental region where the rate exceeded 100%. Substantial inter-regional disparities were observed in catch-up rates, ranging from 79.05% in Eddakhla-Oued Eddahab to 16.12% in Guelmim-Oued Noun, and the national incompleteness rate stood at 15.69%.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The campaign was associated with improved verification and strengthened measles vaccination coverage, but regional disparities and incomplete coverage persisted. The authors highlight the need for targeted interventions such as school-based vaccination and digital reminder systems to achieve elimination goals.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform Morocco’s measles elimination strategy by identifying priority regions and recommending tailored interventions to address geographic, health-system, and sociodemographic barriers to vaccination.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on campaign data and descriptive analyses limits causal inference and generalisability, and the use of PCA for regional disparities introduces methodological assumptions. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the lack of control groups or long-term follow-up.

papers.title_zh: 全国 18 岁以下儿童和青少年 麻疹 疫苗接种、验证、追赶和应对运动
papers.source_body_en: In 2023, Morocco experienced a nationwide measles outbreak. From October 2023 to March 2025, a national campaign of measles vaccination, verification, catch-up, and response was launched, targeting children and adolescents under 18 years of age. This study aims to assess and comprehensively describe the campaign’s impact on measles vaccination coverage, highlighting the need to address post-COVID-19 immunization disruptions. Verification rates, incompleteness levels, and catch-up coverage were estimated using national campaign data, and regional disparities were assessed using descriptive statistics, box plots, and principal component analysis (PCA). Results were compared with the international literature on efforts to control measles, particularly in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs). The overall campaign coverage was high, with an average verification rate of 96.64%, particularly strong in the Oriental region, where the rate exceeded 100%, likely reflecting denominator underestimation and/or cross-boundary vaccination flows. However, substantial inter-regional disparities were observed in catch-up rates, ranging from 79.05% in Eddakhla-Oued Eddahab to as low as 16.12% in Guelmim-Oued Noun. These disparities may reflect differences in geographic accessibility, health system capacity, and sociodemographic factors across regions. The national incompleteness rate stood at 15.69%, indicating significant room for improvement. Service disruptions resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic contributed to the decline in immunization rates before the campaign. While the campaign was associated with improved verification and strengthened measles vaccination coverage, regional disparities and incomplete coverage persisted. In the quest for sustainable measles control, Morocco will require targeted interventions, including school-based vaccination, digital reminder systems, and enhanced community engagement, to achieve its elimination goals, informed by best practices from other parts of the world.
papers.abstract_zh: 2023年,摩洛哥经历了全国性的麻疹 暴发。2023年10月至2025年3月,在全国范围内开展了针对18岁以下儿童青少年的“麻疹 疫苗接种、核查、追赶、响应”活动。本研究旨在评估并全面描述该活动对 麻疹 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的影响,强调需要解决 COVID-19 后免疫接种中断问题。使用国家活动数据估计验证率、不完整性水平和追赶覆盖率,并使用描述性统计、箱线图和主成分分析(PCA)评估区域差异。将结果与有关控制 麻疹 的国际文献进行了比较,特别是在低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC)。整体活动覆盖率较高,平均验证率为96.64%,尤其是东方地区,验证率超过100%,可能反映了分母低估和/或跨境疫苗接种流动。然而,地区间追赶率存在显着差异,从 Eddakhla-Oued Eddahab 的 79.05% 到 Guelmim-Oued Noun 的低至 16.12%。这些差异可能反映了各地区地理可达性、卫生系统能力和社会人口因素的差异。全国不完整率为15.69%,改善空间很大。COVID-19 大流行造成的服务中断导致活动前免疫接种率下降。虽然该活动与改进验证和加强 麻疹 疫苗接种 覆盖范围有关,但区域差异和不完整的覆盖范围仍然存在。为了实现可持续的 麻疹 控制,摩洛哥需要借鉴世界其他地区的最佳实践,采取有针对性的干预措施,包括基于学校的 麻疹、数字提醒系统和加强社区参与,以实现消除目标。

papers.title: An orthogonal transcription system enables high-efficiency rescue of measles virus-based vaccine vectors against multiple pathogens
papers.abstract: Recombinant measles virus (rMeV) vectors are promising platforms for vaccine development against emerging infectious diseases due to their safety, stability, and potent immunogenicity. However, conventional rMeV rescue systems frequently exhibit low efficiency, thereby constraining their scalability and throughput. In this study, we developed a modular, helper-virus-free and high-efficiency rescue platform based on an orthogonal transcription system utilizing orthogonal promoters and engineered RNA polymerases fused to an mRNA capping enzyme. This innovative system facilitated robust cytoplasmic manufacture of both genomic and auxiliary components, eliminating the need for helper virus co-infection (such as modified vaccinia virus) and enhancing rescue efficiency by more than 50-fold relative to traditional rescue approaches. Utilizing this technology, we demonstrated the versatility of the platform by successfully generating six rMeV-based vaccine antigen candidates from influenza virus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa , and Brucella spp. All rescued vaccine candidates exhibited stable transgene expression, sustained replication, and strong antigen production. Immunization studies in golden Syrian hamsters verified that the vaccine candidates elicited high titers of neutralizing and antigen-specific antibodies without any observable adverse effects. These results demonstrate that our orthogonal transcription-based platform facilitates the efficient and safe production of rMeV vectors and provides a proof-of-concept methodological framework for the rapid development of vaccine candidates.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Recombinant measles virus (rMeV) vectors are promising vaccine platforms but conventional rescue systems suffer from low efficiency, limiting scalability. This study addressed the need for a high-efficiency rescue platform to enable rapid development of rMeV-based vaccine candidates against emerging pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed and validated a modular, helper-virus-free rescue platform using an orthogonal transcription system with orthogonal promoters and engineered RNA polymerases fused to an mRNA capping enzyme. The platform was applied to generate six rMeV-based vaccine antigen candidates targeting influenza virus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Brucella spp.
analysis.methods: The orthogonal transcription system enabled cytoplasmic manufacture of genomic and auxiliary components without helper virus co-infection, enhancing rescue efficiency by more than 50-fold compared to traditional approaches. Rescued vaccine candidates were assessed for transgene expression stability, replication capacity, and antigen production.
analysis.main_results: All six rMeV-based vaccine candidates demonstrated stable transgene expression, sustained replication, and strong antigen production. Immunization in golden Syrian hamsters elicited high titers of neutralizing and antigen-specific antibodies without observable adverse effects.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as demonstrating that the orthogonal transcription-based platform enables efficient and safe production of rMeV vectors, providing a proof-of-concept methodological framework for rapid vaccine candidate development. The novelty lies in the helper-virus-free, high-efficiency rescue system that eliminates reliance on modified vaccinia virus co-infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This platform could accelerate the development of rMeV-based vaccines against multiple pathogens, supporting pandemic preparedness and reducing reliance on traditional rescue methods. It may also improve vaccine manufacturing scalability and throughput for emerging infectious disease threats.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study demonstrates proof-of-concept in vitro and in a small animal model, which may not fully predict human safety or efficacy. While rescue efficiency was markedly improved, the platform's generalizability across additional pathogens and long-term stability require further validation. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited scope of animal testing and absence of human data.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a helper-virus-free, orthogonal transcription system to rescue recombinant measles virus (rMeV) vaccine vectors with over 50-fold higher efficiency than conventional methods. The platform enabled cytoplasmic production of genomic and auxiliary components without helper virus co-infection, eliminating the need for modified vaccinia virus. Six rMeV-based vaccine candidates targeting influenza virus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Brucella spp. were successfully generated and exhibited stable transgene expression, sustained replication, and strong antigen production. In golden Syrian hamsters, immunization elicited high titers of neutralizing and antigen-specific antibodies without adverse effects. The authors conclude that this system provides a rapid, scalable framework for rMeV vaccine development against emerging pathogens, though further validation in humans and broader pathogen coverage is needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 重组 麻疹病毒 (rMeV) 媒介 是有前景的 疫苗 平台,但传统救援系统效率低下,限制了可扩展性。这项研究解决了对高效救援平台的需求,以实现快速开发基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 候选药物来对抗新出现的病原体。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发并验证了一个模块化、无辅助病毒的救援平台,该平台使用具有正交启动子的正交转录系统以及与 mRNA 加帽酶融合的工程化 RNA 聚合酶。该平台用于生成六种基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 候选抗原,针对流感病毒、铜绿假单胞菌和布鲁氏菌属。
elements_zh.methods: 正交转录系统能够在细胞质中制造基因组和辅助成分,而无需辅助病毒共感染,与传统方法相比,救援效率提高了 50 倍以上。对获救的 疫苗 候选者进行转基因表达稳定性、复制能力和抗原产生的评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有六种基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 候选物均表现出稳定的转基因表达、持续的复制和强大的抗原产生。金色叙利亚仓鼠的免疫引发了高滴度的中和抗体和抗原特异性抗体,且没有观察到不良反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明基于正交转录的平台能够高效、安全地生产 rMeV 媒介,为快速 疫苗 候选药物开发提供概念验证方法框架。新颖之处在于无辅助病毒的高效救援系统,消除了对改良痘苗病毒合并感染的依赖。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该平台可以加速针对多种病原体的基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 的开发,支持大流行的防范并减少对传统救援方法的依赖。它还可以提高 疫苗 的制造可扩展性和应对新出现的传染病威胁的吞吐量。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究在体外和小动物模型中进行了概念验证,这可能无法完全预测人类的安全性或有效性。虽然救援效率显着提高,但该平台对其他病原体的通用性和长期稳定性需要进一步验证。由于动物试验范围有限且缺乏人体数据,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 重组 麻疹病毒 (rMeV) 媒介 是有前景的 疫苗 平台,但传统救援系统效率低下,限制了可扩展性。这项研究解决了对高效救援平台的需求,以实现快速开发基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 候选药物来对抗新出现的病原体。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发并验证了一个模块化、无辅助病毒的救援平台,该平台使用具有正交启动子的正交转录系统以及与 mRNA 加帽酶融合的工程化 RNA 聚合酶。该平台用于生成六种基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 候选抗原,针对流感病毒、铜绿假单胞菌和布鲁氏菌属。
analysis_zh.methods: 正交转录系统能够在细胞质中制造基因组和辅助成分,而无需辅助病毒共感染,与传统方法相比,救援效率提高了 50 倍以上。对获救的 疫苗 候选者进行转基因表达稳定性、复制能力和抗原产生的评估。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有六种基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 候选物均表现出稳定的转基因表达、持续的复制和强大的抗原产生。金色叙利亚仓鼠的免疫引发了高滴度的中和抗体和抗原特异性抗体,且没有观察到不良反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明基于正交转录的平台能够高效、安全地生产 rMeV 媒介,为快速 疫苗 候选药物开发提供概念验证方法框架。新颖之处在于无辅助病毒的高效救援系统,消除了对改良痘苗病毒合并感染的依赖。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该平台可以加速针对多种病原体的基于 rMeV 的 疫苗 的开发,支持大流行的防范并减少对传统救援方法的依赖。它还可以提高 疫苗 的制造可扩展性和应对新出现的传染病威胁的吞吐量。

papers.title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
papers.abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

papers.title: The Measles Serology Initiative: A Quality Improvement Intervention to Increase Provider Compliance with Rubeola Serology Screening
papers.abstract: Purpose The purpose of this quality improvement (QI) project was to increase provider adherence to Rubeola IgG serology screening during prenatal visits at an outpatient women’s health clinic by 10% from a baseline adherence rate of 63.3%. Background Rubeola remains a highly contagious viral infection that poses health risks for nonimmune pregnant patients and their newborns. With increasing Rubeola cases and the importance of identifying immunity status during pregnancy, consistent prenatal screening practices are essential. Baseline data demonstrated inconsistent adherence to Rubeola IgG screening recommendations, highlighting the need for workflow interventions to improve provider compliance. Methodology A pre-post QI design guided by the Iowa Model and Donabedian framework evaluated interventions consisting of provider education, visual workflow cues, and audit-and-feedback. Pre-intervention data included 2,568 chart reviews from October 2025 to January 2026. Post-intervention data included 2,173 chart reviews from January to April 2026. Data were analyzed by comparing pre- and post-intervention adherence rates. Project limitations included manual chart extraction due to limited access to Epic reporting. Results Provider adherence to Rubeola IgG screening increased from 63.3% pre- intervention to 75.1% post-intervention, an 11.8% increase. Implications The implementation of provider education, visual cues, and audit-and-feedback showed that workflow-based interventions can improve adherence to evidence-based serology screening practices. These strategies identify nonimmune individuals, reduce community transmission during the surge, protect vulnerable populations, and avoid the operational costs of a facility outbreak.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹 血清学 计划:提高服务提供商对 Rubeola 血清学 筛查合规性的质量改进干预措施
papers.source_body_en: Purpose The purpose of this quality improvement (QI) project was to increase provider adherence to Rubeola IgG serology screening during prenatal visits at an outpatient women’s health clinic by 10% from a baseline adherence rate of 63.3%. Background Rubeola remains a highly contagious viral infection that poses health risks for nonimmune pregnant patients and their newborns. With increasing Rubeola cases and the importance of identifying immunity status during pregnancy, consistent prenatal screening practices are essential. Baseline data demonstrated inconsistent adherence to Rubeola IgG screening recommendations, highlighting the need for workflow interventions to improve provider compliance. Methodology A pre-post QI design guided by the Iowa Model and Donabedian framework evaluated interventions consisting of provider education, visual workflow cues, and audit-and-feedback. Pre-intervention data included 2,568 chart reviews from October 2025 to January 2026. Post-intervention data included 2,173 chart reviews from January to April 2026. Data were analyzed by comparing pre- and post-intervention adherence rates. Project limitations included manual chart extraction due to limited access to Epic reporting. Results Provider adherence to Rubeola IgG screening increased from 63.3% pre- intervention to 75.1% post-intervention, an 11.8% increase. Implications The implementation of provider education, visual cues, and audit-and-feedback showed that workflow-based interventions can improve adherence to evidence-based serology screening practices. These strategies identify nonimmune individuals, reduce community transmission during the surge, protect vulnerable populations, and avoid the operational costs of a facility outbreak.

papers.title: Vaccine antibody responses in children with inborn errors of metabolism on protein-restricted diets: an overlooked silent risk?
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Despite routine vaccination recommendations, concerns remain about vaccine-induced immune responses in some patients with inborn errors of metabolism (IEM). Therefore, antibody levels against vaccine antigens should be monitored to detect possible immune dysfunction. The aim of this study is to evaluate the vaccine antibody responses among children with IEM who have to follow protein restricted diet, and to compare with those in healthy children, and also to identify the factors affecting vaccine antibody responses in these patients. METHODS: Anti-HBs and measles immunoglobulin G results of 25 patients diagnosed with amino acid metabolism disorder; phenylketonuria, organic acidemia, homocystinuria and urea cycle disorder, and 58 healthy children of the same age and gender were recorded. Seropositivity rates and titers were compared between two groups, and also with age, daily protein intake, diet duration, total protein, albumin and hemoglobin levels. RESULTS: Seropositivity against hepatitis B was 64 %, and against measles was 80 % in the patient group, and these seropositivity rates were lower than those in the control group. These results show that the trend of the findings was maintained even after adjustment for age. No significant differences in vaccine antibody responses was found among disease subgroups. CONCLUSIONS: As children receiving long-term protein-restricted diets may demonstrate reduced vaccine antibody responses, these findings warrant confirmation in larger prospective studies. We believe that vaccine antibody responses should also be reviewed during metabolic follow-up in these patients.
papers.journal: Journal of pediatric endocrinology & metabolism : JPEM

analysis.scope_and_question: The study focuses on evaluating vaccine antibody responses in children with inborn errors of metabolism (IEM) on protein-restricted diets, specifically comparing them to healthy children. The central question is whether these dietary restrictions affect immune responses to vaccines, particularly measles and hepatitis B, and identifying factors influencing these responses.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single study involving 25 patients with amino acid metabolism disorders (phenylketonuria, organic acidemia, homocystinuria, and urea cycle disorder) and 58 healthy children of the same age and gender. The study compared seropositivity rates and titers of antibodies against measles and hepatitis B antigens, adjusting for age and other factors such as daily protein intake, diet duration, and blood parameters.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that seropositivity against hepatitis B was 64% and against measles was 80% in the patient group, both lower than in the control group. These results remained consistent even after adjusting for age, indicating a potential impact of protein-restricted diets on vaccine antibody responses. However, no significant differences were observed among disease subgroups.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study acknowledges that its findings need confirmation in larger prospective studies due to the limited sample size. Additionally, it does not provide detailed information on the mechanisms underlying the reduced antibody responses or the long-term implications of these findings for vaccine efficacy in IEM patients.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The study suggests that vaccine antibody responses should be reviewed during metabolic follow-up in children with IEM. It highlights the need for further research to confirm these findings and to explore the factors affecting immune responses in this population.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates vaccine antibody responses in children with inborn errors of metabolism (IEM) on protein-restricted diets, comparing them to healthy children. The study found lower seropositivity rates against measles and hepatitis B antigens in IEM patients, even after adjusting for age. However, no significant differences were observed among disease subgroups. The findings suggest that immune responses to vaccines may be affected by dietary restrictions, warranting further research and monitoring during metabolic follow-up. The study emphasizes the need for larger prospective studies to validate these results and understand the underlying mechanisms.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是评估患有先天性代谢缺陷(IEM)的儿童在蛋白质限制饮食中的 疫苗 抗体反应,特别是与健康儿童进行比较。核心问题是这些饮食限制是否影响 免疫应答 至 疫苗,特别是 麻疹 和乙型肝炎,并确定影响这些反应的因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于一项涉及 25 名氨基酸代谢紊乱(苯丙酮尿症、有机酸血症、高胱氨酸尿症和尿素循环障碍)患者和 58 名相同年龄和性别的健康儿童的研究。该研究比较了 麻疹 和乙型肝炎抗原的血清阳性率和抗体滴度,并调整了年龄和其他因素,例如每日蛋白质摄入量、饮食持续时间和血液参数。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,患者组乙型肝炎血清阳性率为 64%,麻疹 血清阳性率为 80%,均低于对照组。即使在调整年龄后,这些结果仍然保持一致,表明蛋白质限制饮食对 疫苗 抗体反应的潜在影响。然而,疾病亚组之间没有观察到显着差异。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究承认,由于样本量有限,其研究结果需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中得到证实。此外,它没有提供有关抗体反应减少的机制的详细信息,也没有提供这些发现对 IEM 患者中 疫苗 疗效的长期影响的详细信息。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该研究表明,在 IEM 儿童的代谢随访过程中应审查 疫苗 抗体反应。它强调需要进一步研究来证实这些发现并探索影响该人群中 免疫应答 的因素。

papers.title_zh: 疫苗 在蛋白质限制饮食中患有先天性代谢缺陷的儿童中的抗体反应:一个被忽视的沉默风险?
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: Despite routine vaccination recommendations, concerns remain about vaccine-induced immune responses in some patients with inborn errors of metabolism (IEM). Therefore, antibody levels against vaccine antigens should be monitored to detect possible immune dysfunction. The aim of this study is to evaluate the vaccine antibody responses among children with IEM who have to follow protein restricted diet, and to compare with those in healthy children, and also to identify the factors affecting vaccine antibody responses in these patients. METHODS: Anti-HBs and measles immunoglobulin G results of 25 patients diagnosed with amino acid metabolism disorder; phenylketonuria, organic acidemia, homocystinuria and urea cycle disorder, and 58 healthy children of the same age and gender were recorded. Seropositivity rates and titers were compared between two groups, and also with age, daily protein intake, diet duration, total protein, albumin and hemoglobin levels. RESULTS: Seropositivity against hepatitis B was 64 %, and against measles was 80 % in the patient group, and these seropositivity rates were lower than those in the control group. These results show that the trend of the findings was maintained even after adjustment for age. No significant differences in vaccine antibody responses was found among disease subgroups. CONCLUSIONS: As children receiving long-term protein-restricted diets may demonstrate reduced vaccine antibody responses, these findings warrant confirmation in larger prospective studies. We believe that vaccine antibody responses should also be reviewed during metabolic follow-up in these patients.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是评估患有先天性代谢缺陷(IEM)的儿童在蛋白质限制饮食中的 疫苗 抗体反应,特别是与健康儿童进行比较。核心问题是这些饮食限制是否影响 免疫应答 至 疫苗,特别是 麻疹 和乙型肝炎,并确定影响这些反应的因素。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于一项涉及 25 名氨基酸代谢紊乱(苯丙酮尿症、有机酸血症、高胱氨酸尿症和尿素循环障碍)患者和 58 名相同年龄和性别的健康儿童的研究。该研究比较了 麻疹 和乙型肝炎抗原的血清阳性率和抗体滴度,并调整了年龄和其他因素,例如每日蛋白质摄入量、饮食持续时间和血液参数。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,患者组乙型肝炎血清阳性率为 64%,麻疹 血清阳性率为 80%,均低于对照组。即使在调整年龄后,这些结果仍然保持一致,表明蛋白质限制饮食对 疫苗 抗体反应的潜在影响。然而,疾病亚组之间没有观察到显着差异。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究承认,由于样本量有限,其研究结果需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中得到证实。此外,它没有提供有关抗体反应减少的机制的详细信息,也没有提供这些发现对 IEM 患者中 疫苗 疗效的长期影响的详细信息。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该研究表明,在 IEM 儿童的代谢随访过程中应审查 疫苗 抗体反应。它强调需要进一步研究来证实这些发现并探索影响该人群中 免疫应答 的因素。

papers.title: Feasibility of establishing a serosurveillance system using residual specimens from district-level hospitals: A case study in Choma and Ndola Districts of Zambia.
papers.abstract: Residual blood specimens collected at health care facilities provide a low-cost and readily available specimen source to monitor population immunity through serological surveillance compared to more resource-intensive probability-based surveys. Despite concerns about the representativeness of these specimens, there has recently been increased interest in the use of residual specimens, driven by the need for rapid estimates of seroprevalence during outbreaks to inform response and prevention. Although residual specimen collection is a key component of surveillance systems in some settings, there is limited evidence of its implementation in low- and middle-income countries. We conducted a pilot project at three health facilities in two districts in Zambia between September 2021 through July 2022 to demonstrate the feasibility of residual blood specimen collection integrated into the health system to estimate measles seroprevalence. Through this pilot project, we were able to collect residual pediatric and adult specimens but with some modifications needed if residual specimen collection were to be implemented at scale, such as better integration into the routine functioning of laboratories and health facilities. This paper summarizes our experiences designing and implementing this residual blood specimen collection, including the lessons learned and recommendations for collecting residual specimens from hospitals.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need for low-cost, rapidly deployable serological surveillance during outbreaks, highlighting a gap in evidence for implementing residual specimen-based serosurveillance in low- and middle-income countries.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A pilot project was conducted at three health facilities in Choma and Ndola Districts, Zambia, between September 2021 and July 2022 to assess the feasibility of integrating residual blood specimen collection into routine health systems for measles seroprevalence estimation.
analysis.methods: The pilot integrated residual blood specimen collection into existing health system workflows to estimate measles seroprevalence, with modifications identified for potential scale-up.
analysis.main_results: The pilot successfully collected residual pediatric and adult specimens, though modifications were required for broader implementation, such as improved integration with laboratory and health facility routines.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated the feasibility of using residual specimens for serosurveillance in resource-limited settings, addressing a critical gap in surveillance infrastructure and providing actionable lessons for scale-up.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of residual specimens to generate rapid seroprevalence estimates, which can inform outbreak response and prevention strategies in low-resource settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the small scale of the pilot and the lack of representativeness of residual specimens, warranting cautious interpretation and further validation in larger studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the feasibility of establishing a serosurveillance system using residual blood specimens from district-level hospitals in Zambia to estimate measles seroprevalence. Conducted as a pilot project at three health facilities in Choma and Ndola Districts between September 2021 and July 2022, the project integrated residual specimen collection into routine health system workflows. The pilot successfully collected residual pediatric and adult specimens but identified the need for modifications, such as better integration with laboratory and health facility routines, for broader implementation. The study demonstrated that residual specimens can provide low-cost, rapidly available data for seroprevalence estimation, addressing a critical gap in surveillance infrastructure in low- and middle-income countries. However, the small scale and non-representative nature of residual specimens limit the generalizability of the findings.

papers.title: Integrating disease mapping and flexible scan statistics to identify and visualize spatial clusters.
papers.abstract: Accurately characterizing the spatial distribution of diseases is essential for understanding etiology and guiding targeted public health interventions. This study develops an analytical framework integrating disease mapping and spatial scan statistics to identify and validate the spatial clustering patterns of diseases. The framework follows an "exploration-validation-refinement" workflow, combining qualitative visualization with quantitative spatial analysis. Choropleth maps intuitively depict the overall distribution of diseases, providing a basis for identifying potential high-risk areas; the flexible scan statistics (FleXScan) method detects statistically significant clusters; and dot cartograms further reveal internal heterogeneity within the most likely clusters by controlling for population density. This study validated the framework using both synthetic data and real measles case data. The results indicate that the framework substantially improves the accuracy and reliability of cluster detection, facilitates the localization of local high-risk cores, and provides actionable insights for precision disease control.

papers.title: Epidemiological features of mumps, epidemiological surveillance and prevention in the world and in the Russian Federation at the present stage
papers.abstract: Despite the fact that mumps has been a vaccine-preventable infection for many years, it continues to be an urgent public health problem. Epidemiological surveillance and vaccine prophylaxis for mumps are carried out comprehensively together with measles and rubella. At the same time, mumps is given much less attention than measles and rubella. Aim : to assess the epidemic situation of mumps in the world and in the Russian Federation, the coverage of vaccination, revaccination and the timeliness of their implementation in Russia. To compare the incidence of mumps, measles and rubella. Materials and methods . A retrospective epidemiological analysis of the incidence of mumps in the world for the period 2012–2024 was carried out in comparison with the incidence of measles and rubella, as well as in the Russian Federation for the period 2007–2024, taking into account the distribution of the incidence of mumps and the structure of cases by age group. The coverage of preventive mumps vaccinations for the period 2012-2024 and the timeliness of vaccination for the period 2021–2024 in the Russian Federation are analyzed. The sample was taken from the World Health Organization database and from the federal statistical observation forms (No. The reliability of the differences was assessed using confidence intervals. The analysis showed that the incidence of mumps in the world and in the Russian Federation differs from the incidence of measles and rubella. In particular, the incidence increases do not always coincide, there are cyclical features and there are differences in the most epidemiologically significant age groups. The incidence of mumps in Russia, although at low numbers, tends to increase (the average annual growth rate is 7.8 %). The highest incidence rate is observed in the group of children aged 3–6 years (3.19 ± 0.22 per 100 thousand. of the corresponding population group), while the lowest incidence rate is in the group of children under 1 year of age (0.5 ± 0.17 per 100 thousand of the corresponding population group). It should be noted that the measles incidence rate is the highest in the group of children under 1 year of age. At the same time, the incidence of mumps among children under 1 year of age is growing at the highest rate of incidence (an increase rate of 4.6 %). The largest contribution to the structure of cases is made by groups of children aged 7–14 years and 3–6 years, the proportion of the total number of cases is 20.3 % and 19.9 %, respectively. The coverage of preventive vaccinations in the Russian Federation decreased against the background of the pandemic and by 2024 has not yet reached pre-pandemic values, while it should be noted that coverage is achieved only by 24 months. Revaccination coverage in 2023 and 2024 amounted to 71.27 % and 92.3 %, respectively. The presence of an upward trend in the incidence of mumps, high levels of morbidity in children aged 3–6 and 7–14 years, as well as the greatest contribution of these age groups to the structure of cases indicate a worsening epidemic situation for this infection. To a certain extent, the reasons for the deterioration of the epidemic situation are late vaccination and insufficient vaccination coverage. At the same time, differences in the incidence of mumps from the incidence of measles and rubella require consideration of changing approaches to epidemiological surveillance and prevention of mumps.

papers.title: A Rapid Detection of Nipah Virus Nucleocapsid Antigen in Inactivated Viral Cultures.
papers.abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a highly lethal zoonotic henipavirus that causes severe respiratory disease and encephalitis and remains a priority pathogen for outbreak preparedness. Timely diagnosis is essential for containment, yet nucleic acid-based testing is often impractical in outbreak-prone, resource-limited settings. Here, we report the development of a rapid antigen test for NiV based on a cellulose nanobead (CNB)-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA) targeting the viral nucleocapsid protein (NP). Anti-NiV NP antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries (scFv and Fab) by iterative bio-panning, reformatted as full-length IgGs, and screened using ELISA and immunofluorescence assays. Four lead antibodies were advanced to a sandwich-pairing matrix, which identified an optimized capture-detection configuration (mAb #5 as capture; mAb #2 as detection). Bio-layer interferometry confirmed nanomolar binding affinities for the selected antibodies (KD = 39.50 nM for mAb #5; KD = 26.36 nM for mAb #2). The finalized CNB-LFIA produced results within 15 min and achieved an analytical limit of detection of 1 ng/mL for recombinant NiV NP. The assay observed no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, whereas weak cross-reactivity for measles virus NP was observed only at a high antigen concentration (2 μg/mL). Using γ-irradiated cultured NiV quantified by RT-ddPCR, the LFIA detected viral load down to 4.1 × 107 copies/mL (4.1 × 106 copies/reaction) by a portable reader and 8.3 × 107 copies/mL (8.3 × 106 copies/reaction) by the naked eye. Collectively, this CNB-LFIA provides rapid, equipment-free NiV detection, supporting its potential utility for point-of-care diagnosis in resource-limited settings.

analysis.methods: Anti-NiV nucleocapsid protein antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries, reformatted as full-length IgGs, and screened by ELISA and immunofluorescence assays to identify optimal capture-detection pairs.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the development of a rapid cellulose nanobead-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (CNB-LFIA) for Nipah virus (NiV) nucleocapsid antigen detection. The assay uses human-derived antibodies with nanomolar binding affinities and achieves a 1 ng/mL limit of detection for recombinant NP. It shows no cross-reactivity with several respiratory viruses but weak cross-reactivity with measles virus NP at high antigen concentrations. Using γ-irradiated cultured NiV, the LFIA detected viral loads down to 4.1 × 10^7 copies/mL by reader and 8.3 × 10^7 copies/mL by naked eye. The authors propose the assay as a rapid, equipment-free diagnostic for point-of-care use in outbreak-prone, resource-limited settings. However, the evidence is limited to analytical performance and cultured virus testing, with no clinical validation reported.
